## anu-p03 — C1

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of recognition (pratyabhijñā); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at Māyā standing as other without being different. The rasa is the tranquility of non-duality — no worship-difference in the unsurpassed.*
